product.name: Limbic Access
product.description: An AI assistant for conversational patient intake and clinical decision support in behavioral health services, embedded on websites to streamline assessments and improve diagnostic accuracy.

product.name: Limbic Care
product.description: An AI companion providing on-demand conversational support to patients between therapy sessions, integrated with personalized treatment plans.

product.name: Limbic Layer
product.description: A clinically validated generative AI framework that ensures large language models are safe and compliant for healthcare use.
